name: global_save
comment: The port's global_save mod (docs/LAUNCHER.md "Save anywhere"), run by tests/port/mods.py with the mod on: first_battle_save's route to the field after the first battle (the lab, map 0x206, not an inn's map), the field menu's SAVE entry, STGMCARD's save to card 1 slot 1 (first_battle_save's card steps), Back to the field, a reset and Continue to load it. Port-only (the emulator has no mods); tests/saves/run.py loads the card it writes in the emulator.

steps.comment: CNTY_SEL (overlay_files[22]) loaded: the country / language select

START until the opening movie's map: confirms the default choice 0 = English (cnty_sel_languages[0] = 2 = ENG), records_language 2, once the panels have slid in and the cursor is up (cnty_sel_update_menu step 7 is the only step that reads START, the fade-out steps ignore it); the EU game then goes to map 0xE02 = the opening movie
STDWTITL loaded (map 0xE02, stdwtitl_movie_screen for movie 1)

START skips the movie (stdwtitl_update_movie checks pad pressed bit 3). On the dynarec core the player spins in StGetNext and samples the pad rarely (the STR stream never reaches its last frame), so a short tap can fall between two samples: hold 30 / release 30 until the title screen proper (map 0xE00). On -interpreter the movie decodes normally and the first press skips it

the logo slides in, shines and glows; START opens the New Game / Continue menu only at stdwtitl_menu step 2 (600 ticks there without START start the demo), every other step ignores it, so tap START for 800 frames instead of waiting a fixed time
the menu blinks and the two choices slide out (steps 3-5: 12 + 15 + 6 ticks)
cursor 0 = New Game (the menu opens on cursor 1 = Continue)
confirm until FIELDSTG is loaded: physical CROSS is logical bit 13 (PAD_PRESSED(0xD)) for non-Japanese languages; stdwtitl_title_apply_choice case 1: gamestate_new_game, set_next_map(0x2D7)

the intro (maps 0x2D7-0x2D9), the registration in STPLNMET (map 0x500: CROSS types the name, the default partner set) and the chamber capsule, every line confirmed with CROSS, until the login movie (STDWTITL map 0xE03)

steps.name: login_movie
steps.comment: after the registration: the name, the partner set and the three Digimon records are in gamestate_data

skip the login movie at once with one long START hold, as new_game did first. The dynarec core's STR playback is fragile: waiting 150 frames first, or tapping every 30 frames, made the emulated machine run off (reads from 0x17FF0500, a reset, then 'Unrecoverable error while running recompiler' at PC 0xFF050014), at speed 1 too
the arrival scenes in Asuka (map 0x207, WSTAG225: progress 1 -> 2) until the Main Lobby
Main Lobby (map 0x203, WSTAG210; positions from its attribute map, layer 0): down the ramp (the player can move once the arrival scene ends)
up the stairs
below the Tamer Service counter (actor 49 at (361, 221))
face the counter (direction 5, as event 13 places the player)
talk to Tamer Service (talk 13 starts event 13: the first answer leads to the admin room, map 0x204). Before progress 3 the lobby's exit to the city (map event 6, event 20) turns the player back
the admin room scene (WSTAG212: progress 2 -> 3), the walk to Asuka City (map 0x200), whose progress-3 event starts the first battle (map 0x600)

steps.name: battle_start
steps.comment: FIGHTSTG loaded: the scripted first battle of the story (one enemy)
CROSS on every menu: Fight, the default technique and target; the enemy falls to the first attacks

steps.name: battle_won
steps.comment: STFGTREP (the battle report) loaded: HP/MP after the battle, records_battle_results; the experience is not added yet
through the report

steps.name: battle_end
steps.comment: back in FIELDSTG (map 0x200): the report has added the experience (stfgtrep_add_exp, level-ups and their stat draws)
the post-battle scene in Asuka City, which ends in the lab (map 0x206, progress 4)
the lab's map title fades; the menu needs no event running
the field menu (fieldstg_manager_update: progress 4 reached after the first battle); its three panels slide in

steps.name: menu_open
steps.comment: the menu is open on the lab (map 0x206): field_map and player_pos set
cursor 0 (ITEMS) to 5: the mod's SAVE entry (no card case yet: ITEMS SORT MAP TECHNIQUES STATUS SAVE)
SAVE: the menu's closing animation, then STGMCARD in save mode (map 0xC00, entry -1: port_global_save_open; the lab is not an inn's map)
STGMCARD: choose memory card slot 1 (the default) until the card is accessed (memcard_state.state 2, MemCardAccept)
the runner's card is empty: 'File cannot be found. Create new data?' YES (the default) until the create command (memcard_state.command 8)
after the file's header is written: 'Save here?' on save slot 1, CROSS, until the slot's 0x2700 bytes are written (memcard_state.done)

steps.name: saved_anywhere
steps.comment: the slot is on the card with the map's state in its tail (port_global_save_record)
'Saved.' appears (window animation)
dismiss 'Saved.' (TRIANGLE does nothing there)
Back (TRIANGLE: logical cancel) from the save slots, then from the card choice: STGMCARD returns to the field (map 0x20A)

steps.name: back_after_save
steps.comment: Back from STGMCARD: FIELDSTG on the lab again (prev_map 0xC00: the player at player_pos), map_is_new 0
reboot; the card keeps the save
CNTY_SEL (overlay_files[22]) loaded: the country / language select

START until the opening movie's map: confirms the default choice 0 = English (cnty_sel_languages[0] = 2 = ENG), records_language 2, once the panels have slid in and the cursor is up (cnty_sel_update_menu step 7 is the only step that reads START, the fade-out steps ignore it); the EU game then goes to map 0xE02 = the opening movie
STDWTITL loaded (map 0xE02, stdwtitl_movie_screen for movie 1)

START skips the movie (stdwtitl_update_movie checks pad pressed bit 3). On the dynarec core the player spins in StGetNext and samples the pad rarely (the STR stream never reaches its last frame), so a short tap can fall between two samples: hold 30 / release 30 until the title screen proper (map 0xE00). On -interpreter the movie decodes normally and the first press skips it

the logo slides in, shines and glows; START opens the New Game / Continue menu only at stdwtitl_menu step 2 (600 ticks there without START start the demo), every other step ignores it, so tap START for 800 frames instead of waiting a fixed time
the menu blinks and the two choices slide out (steps 3-5: 12 + 15 + 6 ticks)
the menu opens on Continue (cursor 1): STGMCARD in load mode (map 0xC00, entry 0)
card slot 1, save slot 1, confirm; the load sets the map back to the saved field map

steps.name: loaded_anywhere
steps.comment: FIELDSTG on the lab from the save: compare with saved_anywhere; the map's state restored (port_global_save_restore)
the map title; the actors stand
